name: 收款计划关联合同
description: 收款计划明细带合同信息
statement: SELECT r.id AS id, r.plan_no AS plan_no, r.contract_no AS contract_no, r.period_index AS period_index, r.period_name AS period_name, r.plan_ratio AS plan_ratio, r.plan_amount AS plan_amount, r.plan_date AS plan_date, r.received_amount AS received_amount, r.plan_status AS plan_status, c.contract_name AS contract_name, c.sign_unit AS sign_unit, c.contract_status AS contract_status, c.project_no AS project_no FROM contract_receive_plan r LEFT JOIN contract_main c ON c.contract_no = r.contract_no
